source_evidence_candidates.exact_quote:
Please clarify if the interviewees only expressed their organisational views or if they
additionally could express their personal views as well in answering the questions.

Author Response: The interviewees did not represent their companies but were rather interviewed
as "experts". Some of those even clearly stated that the answers were their personal opinions and
not necessarily the ones of their companies. Therefore, we included the following footnote in the
manuscript: "In addition, the survey inputs are the personal expert assessments of the
interviewees and do not necessarily represent the official views of their organisations."
